Para proveedores de soluciones inteligentes como Eden, es crucial pensar en cómo los radiólogos interactúan con estas herramientas en sus espacios de trabajo. Esto puede marcar la diferencia entre una IA que trabaja con el médico, y una que trabaja en su contra.

La inteligencia de negocios es más que una herramienta para tomar decisiones empresariales. - [Crear una orden](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/api-rest/ordenes/crear-una-orden.md): Al ser una API REST, cada método HTTP tiene el significado esperado, para realizar la creación se utiliza el método POST.

- [Actualizar una orden](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/api-rest/ordenes/actualizar-una-orden.md): Para actualizar una orden existente es necesario contar con el Identificador único generado por Eden. Cuando se realiza la creación, el identificador se envia en la respuesta del servicio.

- [Cancelar una orden](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/api-rest/ordenes/cancelar-una-orden.md): Para cancelar una orden previamente registrada, es necesario contar con el identificador único de la orden generado por Eden
- [Estudios](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/api-rest/estudios.md): Mediante este servicio podrás consultar la URL del visor Eden, el QR con la URL embebida o redirigir directamente al visor

- [Cargar reporte externo a estudio](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/api-rest/estudios/cargar-reporte-externo-a-estudio.md): Este endpoint permite cargar reportes (interpretaciones) a los estudios existentes en Eden PACS

- [Cargar archivo adicional a estudio](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/api-rest/estudios/cargar-archivo-adicional-a-estudio.md): Este endpoint permite cargar archivos adicionales en un estudio, por ejemplo resultados de estudios previos, recetas médicas, datos de identificación, etc.

- [Agendamientos](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/api-rest/agendamientos.md): Tambien tenemos servicios para la gestion de citas o agendamientos, estos servicios permiten la creacion de una cita, la consulta, la modificacion y eliminarla.

- [Creacion de agendamiento](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/api-rest/agendamientos/creacion-de-agendamiento.md): Al ser una API REST, cada método HTTP tiene el significado esperado, para realizar la creación se utiliza el método POST.

- [Consultar agendamientos](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/api-rest/agendamientos/consultar-agendamientos.md): Al ser una API REST, cada método HTTP tiene el significado esperado, para realizar listar los agendamientos se utiliza el método GET.

- [Obtener un agendamiento](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/api-rest/agendamientos/obtener-un-agendamiento.md): Al ser una API REST, cada método HTTP tiene el significado esperado, para realizar listar los agendamientos se utiliza el método GET.

- [Actualizar un agendamiento](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/api-rest/agendamientos/actualizar-un-agendamiento.md): Al ser una API REST, cada método HTTP tiene el significado esperado, para realizar la actualizacion se utiliza el método PUT.

- [Cancelar un agendamiento](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/api-rest/agendamientos/cancelar-un-agendamiento.md): Para este servicio se utiliza el método HTTP DELETE, pero el registro no se borra, solo se cancela y queda en el histórico por si es necesario hacer alguna validación posterior.

- [Crear cotizacion](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/api-rest/cotizaciones/crear-cotizacion.md): Al ser una API REST, cada método HTTP tiene el significado esperado, para realizar la creación se utiliza el método POST.

- [Actualizar cotizacion](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/api-rest/cotizaciones/actualizar-cotizacion.md): Al ser una API REST, cada método HTTP tiene el significado esperado, para realizar la actualizacion se utiliza el método PUT.

- [REST API](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api.md): Here you will find the information needed for integration with the API. In addition, examples are provided on how to perform some of the most common operations available through the API.
- [Authentication](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/authentication.md): Authentication management in our REST services

- [Create an order](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/orders/create-an-order.md): As this is a REST API, each HTTP method has its expected meaning; to perform creation, the POST method is used.
- [View orders](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/orders/view-orders.md): View orders from your organization in Eden
- [Get an order](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/orders/get-an-order.md): Get an order by its ID or the related folio

- [Update an order](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/orders/update-an-order.md): To update an existing order, it is necessary to have the unique identifier generated by Eden. When the creation is performed, the identifier is sent in the service response.

- [Cancel an order](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/orders/cancel-an-order.md): To cancel a previously registered order, it is necessary to have the unique identifier of the order generated by Eden
- [Studies](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/studies.md): Through this service you can consult the Eden viewer URL, the QR with the embedded URL, or redirect directly to the viewer

- [Scheduling](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/scheduling.md): We also have services for appointment or scheduling management; these services allow creating, viewing, modifying, and deleting an appointment.

- [Create scheduling](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/scheduling/create-scheduling.md): As this is a REST API, each HTTP method has its expected meaning; to perform creation, the POST method is used.

- [View schedules](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/scheduling/view-schedules.md): As this is a REST API, each HTTP method has the expected meaning; to list the schedules, the GET method is used.

- [Get a schedule](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/scheduling/get-a-schedule.md): As this is a REST API, each HTTP method has the expected meaning; to list the schedules, the GET method is used.

- [Update a schedule](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/scheduling/update-a-schedule.md): As this is a REST API, each HTTP method has its expected meaning; to perform the update, the PUT method is used.

- [Cancel a schedule](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/scheduling/cancel-a-schedule.md): For this service, the HTTP DELETE method is used, but the record is not deleted; it is only canceled and remains in the history in case any later validation is needed.

- [Create quote](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/quotes/create-quote.md): As this is a REST API, each HTTP method has its expected meaning; to perform creation, the POST method is used.

- [Update quote](https://docs-middleware.edenmed.com/en/rest-api/quotes/update-quote.md): As this is a REST API, each HTTP method has its expected meaning; to perform the update, the PUT method is used.

citations.title: Privacy Policy — Eden
excerpts: 12\.2 Sub-processors. Eden may use sub-processors (including cloud infrastructure providers such as Amazon Web Services, Inc.) for the storage and processing of data. Eden guarantees that every sub-processor will be subject to contractual obligations equivalent to those contained in this Notice, will undergo a prior risk assessment, and will maintain an up-to-date register of sub-processors available for consultation.

12\.3 Representative in the European Union. In accordance with Article 27 of the GDPR, where Higia, Inc. or any subsidiary not established in the EU acts as controller of the data of individuals located in the European Union or the European Economic Area, Eden will designate a representative established in a member state. The representative will serve as an additional point of contact for supervisory authorities and Data Subjects in the EU. The representative's contact details will be published at legal.edenmed.com.

12\.4 Business Associate Agreements (BAA) in the United States. Where Eden provides services to entities qualified as a "covered entity" under the U.S. Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), Eden will enter into a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) in accordance with the requirements of the HIPAA Privacy Rule (45 CFR § 164.502(e)) and the HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR §§ 164.308, 164.310, 164.312). The BAA will establish Eden's obligations as a "business associate," including the limitations on the use and disclosure of Protected Health Information (PHI).

citations.title: Member of Technical Staff, AI Research – Radiology Foundation Model at Eden | Y Combinator
excerpts: Eden is the largest cloud native and AI native medical imaging OS. Our platform is used by 2,500+ imaging centers across 18 countries. We see 20M+ patients per year, and over 4 billion medical images spanning diverse populations that are chronically underrepresented in typical training sets. Thousands of Radiologists use our software every shift. This isn't a research prototype.

We're training multimodal foundation models for radiology. Eden is the diagnostic system of record at the centers we serve. That lets us train on all the clinical information that goes into a radiologist's read, and ensures every model output is reviewed and signed off by a radiologist during normal clinical work. That's a feedback loop most research teams don't have access to.
**What you'll work on:** VLM architecture, training, and evaluation for radiology workflows. Clinical validation and dataset curation at a scale most researchers never get access to.

* You've trained non-trivial VLMs or LLMs end-to-end. Pretraining, large-scale SFT, continued pretraining, or post-training (RLHF / DPO / GRPO). Research or production both count. Inference on public checkpoints or lightweight LoRA tuning doesn't.
